screenshots.alt: Workboard prioritizing requests that need input and increments ready for review.
screenshots.caption: Workboard with deterministic sample requests. Choose the next request to advance; authoring, conversation and review have separate focused views.

screenshots.alt: Project directory showing isolated Home checkout paths and an explicit Add a project action.
screenshots.caption: Choose a registered project. Cloning, workflow publication, exact policy approval and intake recheck are separate explicit steps.

screenshots.alt: Focused New Feature Request view with project, goal, acceptance criteria and explicit Git publication.
screenshots.caption: One project request, from its committed template to an explicit publication decision. Draft preparation does not invoke a model or commit to Git.

screenshots.alt: Worker health with resources, measured consumption and execution activity.
screenshots.caption: Worker health with deterministic sample measurements. Resource use and allowance are separate from delivery quality and live provider account balances.

screenshots.alt: Workflow health with recorded stage pressure, confirmed-increment velocity and measurement coverage.
screenshots.caption: Recorded delivery health and operational EBM proxies. Unmeasured customer or business outcomes remain unavailable rather than being inferred.

screenshots.alt: Feature Request review with the accepted goal, changed files, required checks and the next human action.
screenshots.caption: The real review workspace with a fictional verified candidate and a policy requiring human acceptance. Recording acceptance is separate from merging the change.

screenshots.alt: Settings directory grouping independent worker settings by the task to perform.
screenshots.caption: Choose one setting, then edit it on its own focused view. Provider connection, default provider, capacity and time limits have independent saves.
